name: bambu-lab-discord
description: Discord bot for monitoring Bambu Lab 3D printers over MQTT

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc && mkdir -p dist/libs/bambu-tls dist/tools/mock-mqtt-printer && cp src/libs/bambu-tls/bambu-printer-ca.pem dist/libs/bambu-tls/bambu-printer-ca.pem && cp -R src/tools/mock-mqtt-printer/web dist/tools/mock-mqtt-printer/web
scripts.lint: eslint src/ tests/ vitest.config.mts --max-warnings 0 && pnpm run format:check
scripts.format:check: prettier --check '.amp/**/*.yaml' '.github/**/*.{json,yml,yaml}' 'scenarios/**/*.json' 'src/tools/mock-mqtt-printer/web/**/*.{css,html,js}' .prettierrc .release-please-manifest.json compose.yaml eslint.config.mjs nodemon.json package.json release-please-config.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.mts
